title: Futu Holdings Wins Five CME Awards, Cementing Industry Leadership in Futures and Options Providing Flexible and Diversified Investment Portfolios for Global Investors
summary: (Hong Kong - 1 February, 2026) Futu Holdings Limited (Nasdaq: FUTU), a globally leading securities trading and wealth management fintech platform, is pleased to announce that its subsidiary, Futu Securities International (Hong Kong) Limited (“Futu"), has received five prestigious awards from the Chicago Mercantile Exchange (CME). This achievement solidifies Futu's leading position and expertise in the futures and options domain. Over the years, Futu is committed to providing diversified futures and options trading services for global investors with extensive customer coverage, earning recognition from worldwide major global exchanges and authoritative institutions for its outstanding performance in exchange product trading and derivatives investments.
